description: Waits for a network response matching the specified URL and HTTP method, with an optional timeout. Returns the response JSON.
code: async waitForResponse(url: string, method: string, timeout = 60000) { ... }

description: Retrieves previously stored data from the World object for use in assertions or subsequent actions.

parameters.name: property
parameters.desc: Property name in the World object to retrieve

code:
// Example: get API response from world
const response = world.responseData;

description: Stores data in the World object for later retrieval in other steps or hooks. Typically used to persist API responses, test data, or shared state between steps.

parameters.name: property
parameters.desc: Property name to store the value under

parameters.name: value
parameters.desc: Value to store (e.g., API response, test data, etc.)

code:
// Example: store API response in world
world.responseData = await this.waitForResponse(...);

description: Defines a step that uses the ScenarioWorld context (`this`) to manage shared state and pass test data to page object methods.

parameters.name: this
parameters.desc: Shared state object for the scenario

parameters.name: dataTable
parameters.desc: Cucumber data table containing test data

description: Asserts that the actual value strictly equals the expected value. Commonly used for validating API response codes, UI values, and other outputs.
Navigates the browser to the specified URL using Playwright.

pattern:
await expect(<locator>).toHaveText(<text>)
await expect(<locator>).toContainText(<text>)
await expect(<locator>).toBeVisible()
description: Validates that a page element has specific text content or is visible. Useful Playwright matchers include `toHaveText`, `toContainText`, and `toBeVisible`.

pattern: let data = await import('<path/to/json>'); let keyData = data[<testdataKey>];
example_usage:
let data = await import('../fixtures/testdata/myfile.json');
let keyData = data[testdata];
description: Dynamically imports a JSON test data file at runtime and extracts a specific dataset using a key. Enables parameterized and data-driven testing.

parameters.name: path
parameters.desc: Relative path to the JSON test data file

parameters.name: testdataKey
parameters.desc: Key to retrieve a specific dataset from the imported JSON
